info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking It Management Systems Administration By Systems Administration Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to retrieve information about a specific banking IT management systems administration record using its unique identifier. It serves as a vital resource for developers seeking to integrate detailed system administration data into their applications. Typical consumers include financial institutions and IT departments that require quick access to system management details for auditing or operational purposes. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure efficient governance of their IT management systems.
